description: UK PlanIt is a national aggregator of current and historical planning application information, collected from UK planning authorities, that can be searched by rectangle, circle, postcode, boundary, area or identifier and browsed by region and authority. When read it covered 417 planning authorities, more than 30 of them not up to date, with details of about 20.4 million applications, 91% of which can be located on a map. An API returns full details of applications and planning areas and supports searches by identifier, radius around a point or postcode and other filters, in CSV, GeoJSON, GeoRSS, JSON or TSV, with a data dictionary; access is rate limited. The site was built by Andrew Speakman and follows earlier work by PlanningAlerts, ScraperWiki and OpenlyLocal. Coverage: planning authorities across England, Wales, Scotland, Northern Ireland and the Channel Islands. Access: free website and API. Licence: open postcode and boundary sources; linked documents stay under local authority copyright. Caveats: records are scraped from authority websites, so completeness and freshness vary. Simulation uses are pipelines of proposed development for future building stock and demand scenarios. Related records: the Planning Data platform for England.
